ns2:section.sectionText: This course traces the meaning of “Shakespeare” in a variety of time periods and geographic locations, including our own production of A Winter’s Tale. Starting with early modern staging and moving through colonial Indian productions, 19th century American adaptations, mid-twentieth century Broadway musicals, millennial film adaptation, and 21st century university production, we’ll develop skills for conducting historical research. Ultimately, this class interrogates the place of Shakespeare in the university curriculum and on contemporary stages.
